name: Volatility and GARCH
description: Model how volatility clusters, and forecast risk from it.

lessonObjectives.l1-calm-and-storms: See volatility clustering in a return series.
lessonObjectives.l3-fat-tails: Measure kurtosis and compare the tails of returns with a normal.
lessonObjectives.l4-realised-vol: Compute realised volatility over different windows.
lessonObjectives.l5-recent-days-more: Estimate volatility with an exponentially weighted moving average.
lessonObjectives.l6-arch: Write down the ARCH(1) model and simulate it.
lessonObjectives.l7-garch11: Fit a GARCH(1,1) model and read its persistence.
lessonObjectives.l8-long-run-variance: Compute the long-run variance from GARCH parameters.
lessonObjectives.l9-forecasting-vol: Forecast volatility several days ahead and watch it revert.
lessonObjectives.l10-value-at-risk: Compute value at risk from a volatility forecast.
lessonObjectives.l11-checking-var: Count VaR breaches and test whether there are too many.
lessonObjectives.l12-vol-targeting: Scale a position to hit a volatility target.
